SELECT g.id AS id, g.name AS name, g.phone_num AS phoneNum, g.description AS description, g.address AS address, g.file AS file, g.background_img AS backgroundImg, g.br_file AS brFile, g.address_detail AS addressDetail, g.postcode AS postcode, g.latitude AS latitude, g.longitude AS longitude, g.facility AS facility, g.user_id AS userId,
IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), 0) AS rating, COUNT(r.id) AS reviewCount
FROM GYM g
LEFT JOIN REVIEW r ON g.id = r.gym_id
WHERE g.id = #{value}
GROUP BY g.id, g.name, g.phone_num, g.description, g.address, g.file, g.background_img, g.br_file, g.address_detail, g.postcode, g.latitude, g.longitude, g.facility, g.user_id
